task.claim:
Let phi satisfy phi^2 + phi - 1 = 0, so the norm form of Z[phi] is
N(a + b*phi) = a^2 - ab - b^2 (equivalently a^2 + ab - b^2 under b -> -b).
2 is inert in Z[phi]: for all integers a, b not both zero there are k >= 0
and an odd integer m with a^2 + ab - b^2 = 4^k * m. Hence the 2-adic
valuation of every nonzero norm from Z[phi] is even (README item 7:
"2 is inert in Z[phi], so v2(#J) is always even").
